name: Knowledge Graph Research Scientist
role_description: Conducts research on constructing and modeling knowledge graphs from document collections, working with node and edge representations to advance information retrieval and natural language processing systems.

name: NLP Research Scientist
role_description: Studies multi-hop question answering systems by benchmarking datasets and analyzing knowledge graph structures to improve retrieval and reasoning models.

name: Dr. Elena Marsh
role_description: A computational chemistry researcher who benchmarks AI agents and large language models on organic synthesis planning tasks, and studies how reliable automated evaluators are at judging chemical reasoning quality.
